Floating scribe box + toggled pages

The Funeral Procession at 1280×720, set in IM Fell DW Pica. Click the buttons inside the frames, or press T, J or Esc while the mouse is over a frame.

1 · Play screen

The three bottom cards become one floating box over the text register. The figures stay uncovered and the scene gets the full height. A red rubric tab names who is speaking, as on the scroll. The held piece sits in a small slot to the left, only while something is held. Rites and Journal turn into two buttons on the right that show progress. A red dot means the journal has a new entry, and Rites flashes green when a rite is finished.

2 · Rites page (T)

A short scroll sheet over the dimmed scene. Finished rites are struck through in green with a tick. The current rite is shaded. Tabs on top switch between pages, and Esc closes.

3 · Journal page (J)

Figures are grouped by plate. Unrecorded figures show as dashed blanks, so you can see which plates still hold something to find. Click a figure to read it on the right. Clicking a blank only says which plate to look in.
